basics.name: Victor Svizev
basics.label: Senior Magento / Adobe Commerce developer
basics.summary: Certified senior Magento / Adobe Commerce developer with 9+ years of experience working in distributed teams on commercial extension development, platform upgrades, and compatibility engineering. Independently designs, builds, and sells Magento extensions on the Adobe Commerce Marketplace, with 100+ sales. Experienced in integrating Magento with modern solutions, including Hyvä Theme and Adobe App Builder, as well as in AI-assisted development.

work.name: TechDivision GmbH
highlights: Evolve and maintain a large ecosystem of 140+ Magento extensions, including Symfony-based components.
Draft technical concepts and development tickets, and maintain technical and end-user documentation.
Develop new modules and features, refactor code, and resolve issues.
Expand test coverage for new features and modules, including regression tests and edge cases.
Ensure extension compatibility with new Magento releases (starting with beta versions), as well as with supported PHP versions.
Conduct code reviews to maintain code quality and reliability standards.
Maintain package dependencies, release pipelines, and versioning.
Provide prompt support to internal teams and first-level support to customers – from feature development to issue resolution.
Own major Adobe Commerce upgrades across customer projects.
Develop compatibility modules for Hyvä Theme and Hyvä Checkout.
Develop applications built on Adobe App Builder.
Develop internal Claude Code and OpenCode plugins to integrate AI agents into company-wide development workflows.

work.name: netz98 GmbH – a valantic company
highlights: Contributed to 3 B2B and B2C client projects across 2 teams.
Added new functionalities, adapted third-party extensions, integrated third-party services, and resolved issues.
Expanded test coverage for new functionality and conducted code reviews.

work.name: UNlimited world trade union GmbH
highlights: Owned end-to-end development – frontend, backend customizations, and test environments – for 4 in-house Magento B2B and B2C stores as part of a two-person development team.
Performed migrations from Magento 1.7 to 1.9 and from 1.9 to 2.3, including extension and theme replacements and rewrites, and implemented a custom catalog import.
Maintained and modernized legacy customizations, implemented regulatory store changes, and improved production reliability.
